meta_description: Ali Painters & Decorators Ltd, Birmingham. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painters & Decorators — 15+ Years Local Experience
hero_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior transformations, we deliver quality finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a bedroom refresh or a complete house renovation, we handle interior and exterior work with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with high-quality emulsion or specialist finishes. We prepare surfaces properly, protect your furniture, and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint and protective coatings for fascias, soffits, doors, and rendered walls. We work in all seasons with proper scaffolding.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging on feature walls or full rooms. We source materials, handle pattern matching, and work with modern and traditional papers.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Make a statement with bold feature walls or perfectly coordinated accent colours. We'll help you choose colours that transform your space.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Skirting boards, door frames, and fitted furniture painted to a professional finish. All woodwork sanded, primed, and painted with quality gloss or eggshell.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office refurbishment, shop fronts, and commercial properties completed on schedule with minimal disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: We treat every job like it's our own home — that's how we've earned repeat business.
about_para_1: Ali Painters & Decorators Ltd was established over 15 years ago in Birmingham with a simple philosophy: do the job right, first time. We've built our reputation by showing up on time, protecting your home or business, and finishing work to a standard we'd be proud of in our own houses. Every team member is trained and fully insured.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen to what you want, give honest advice on colours and finishes, and we're not afraid to say no to a job that isn't right for us. We work across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, from Victorian terraces to modern commercial spaces, and we treat every property with respect.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Ali and his team painted our entire bungalow inside and out. Very professional, tidy workers, and they finished bang on time. Would definitely recommend — no mess left behind and the quality is excellent.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had three bedrooms redecorated and a feature wall done. They moved all the furniture, protected everything, and the finish is brilliant. Competitive price too. Very happy with them.
reviews.author: Sandra J.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on external painting after years of neglect. Ali gave honest advice, didn't try to oversell, and the work was meticulous. Scaffolding came and went smoothly. Top job.
reviews.author: David L.
